threats.description: Direct threats or explicit intent to harm another person (including obfuscated spellings).
threats.recommended_action: Review immediately; high priority. Consider deletion and escalation to moderators.

harassment.description: Insults, targeted harassment, encouraging self-harm, and short-form harassment phrases.
harassment.recommended_action: High priority: review for moderation action.

hate_speech.description: Hateful language or slurs targeting protected characteristics. (Contains offensive terms for detection.)
sample_triggers: racial slur used in a sentence
hate_speech.recommended_action: High priority: likely grounds for removal and escalation.

sexual_minors.description: Sexual or explicit content that references minors or underage persons. Patterns aim to detect age mentions in sexual contexts.
sexual_minors.recommended_action: Immediate review; severe policy violation. Escalate to server admins and follow platform policy.

self_harm.description: Expressions of intent to self-harm or suicidal ideation. Useful for flagging messages that may need sensitive intervention.
self_harm.recommended_action: Sensitive: consider non-punitive support steps. Notify moderators or trusted contacts if policy allows.

doxxing.description: Patterns commonly associated with sharing private/personal data (phone numbers, IPs, emails, street addresses).
doxxing.recommended_action: High priority: immediate removal and escalation due to privacy risk.

illegal_activity.description: Explicit instructions or facilitation of illegal activity (weapons, drugs, explosives, fraud).
illegal_activity.recommended_action: Immediate review and removal; severe violation.

sexual_explicit.description: Explicit sexual content not involving minors.
sexual_explicit.recommended_action: Medium priority: may be removed depending on server rules.

spam_phishing.description: Spammy or phishing messages: suspicious shortened links, giveaway scams, and common spam phrases.
spam_phishing.recommended_action: Low-medium: often spam; remove or quarantine.

whitelist.description: Optional phrases or contexts that commonly cause false positives. These are not applied automatically by the scanner but are provided to help tune rules.
whitelist.notes: Consider using these phrases to suppress matches that are known false positives when implementing a refinement step.
